versions.subject: SeriousSAM PowerShell rule
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - '\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy'
        - 'ystem32\config\sam'
selection_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Copy-Item'
        - 'cp $_.'
        - 'cpi $_.'
        - 'copy $_.'
        - '.File]::Copy('
condition: all of them
